In which situation is work done on an object?

options.A: The object slides with a constant velocity along a horizontal frictionless surface in a vacuum.
options.B: A person holds the object at arm’s length and at a fixed height above the ground.
options.C: A person pushes the object up a frictionless ramp.
options.D: The stationary object floats partially submerged in water.

A ball is thrown vertically upwards. Air resistance is negligible.
Which statement is correct?

options.A: By the principle of conservation of energy, the total energy of the ball is constant throughout its motion.
options.B: By the principle of conservation of momentum, the momentum of the ball is constant throughout its motion.
options.C: The kinetic energy of the ball is greatest at the greatest height attained.
options.D: The potential energy of the ball increases at a constant rate during its ascent.
